statement: Measure the proposed metric where the failure happens before switching a guard to it. Incident: on 2026-11-04 the reviewing session moved cejel's scan timing guards from wall time to process.cpuUsage (#662, e3ced20a5), reasoning that CI wall time counted CPU taken by other test workers, but it never measured CPU against wall on CI. On CI, two v27 guards then read 2,347 ms CPU against 1,696 ms wall and 2,318 against 1,954, because process.cpuUsage counts every thread, V8's parallel GC included. The runner was simply slower, so the new budget was stricter and failed twice as many guards. Fix: the guards now budget a non-v17 scan at max(2 s, 3x a v17 scan on the same runner) (f56596201). Rule: print the old and new measure side by side on the failing host before relying on either.

movesWhen.reason: A review-method error by the reviewing session: the corrected guard ships in #662, but the lesson is the method (measure the new metric on the failing host first), which no commit encodes.
